verdict.rationale: Baseten ships an official skill/MCP server so a connected coding agent can 'manage your Baseten workspace' via natural-language instructions, and Baseten Switch lets NL-driven agents route requests to Model APIs, giving AI-native users a path to operate the platform conversationally through an agent rather than a native chat UI. Missing for 10: first-party docs showing example natural-language commands/outcomes for workspace operations, independent/hands-on confirmation the MCP skill reliably performs actions (deploy, scale, etc.), and any native in-product NL command interface.
